proposals.title: Review whether actor first names are required
proposals.description: A completeness check is configurable, but the nullable schema and observed missing value require a business decision before approval.
evidence: The schema allows nulls in actor.first_name.
Profile: 10 rows, 9 non-null values, and 1 null.
assumptions: A missing first name may be either a data defect or a valid representation of a person's name.

proposals.title: Review whether film titles must be unique
proposals.description: A uniqueness check would flag the observed duplicate title, but title uniqueness is not established by the schema.
evidence: The schema does not mark film.title as a key.
Profile: 10 non-null values and 9 distinct values.
assumptions: Different films may legitimately share a title.

proposals.title: Review nonnegative rental-rate requirement
proposals.description: Check that rental rates are at least zero if negative monetary values are invalid for this field.
evidence: film.rental_rate is a decimal column with 10 non-null values and 4 distinct values.
A range check with minimum 0 evaluated 10 rows and found 1 violation.
assumptions: The column represents a charge for which negative values are not valid; this meaning must be confirmed.

proposals.title: Clarify the film rating vocabulary
proposals.description: Document the authoritative set of permitted film rating codes before creating an allowed-values rule.
evidence: film.rating is a nullable text column.
Profile: 10 non-null values and 6 distinct values; the guarded sample disclosed only that an observed value is a short string.
assumptions: The field may use a controlled vocabulary, but its permitted values are not available in the sanitized evidence.

proposals.title: Review inventory-to-film reference integrity
proposals.description: Require each non-null inventory film identifier to match a film identifier if the naming correspondence represents an intended relationship.
evidence: inventory.film_id and film.film_id are compatible integer columns.
A referential check evaluated 10 inventory values and found 1 violation.
The sanitized schema declares no relationships.
assumptions: inventory.film_id is intended to reference film.film_id; identifier names alone are not sufficient confirmation.

proposals.title: Review rental and return chronology
proposals.description: Require a rental date to be no later than its return date if both timestamps describe the same rental lifecycle.
evidence: rental.rental_date and rental.return_date are compatible datetime columns with 10 non-null values each.
The comparison rental_date <= return_date evaluated 10 rows and found 1 violation.
assumptions: The two timestamps describe start and end events in the same lifecycle and equal timestamps are acceptable.

proposals.title: Clarify whether open rentals may lack a return date
proposals.description: Document whether a null return date represents a valid open rental or a completeness defect before adding a completeness rule.
evidence: The schema permits nulls in rental.return_date.
The current profile contains 10 non-null values and 0 nulls.
assumptions: Future data may include rentals that have not yet been returned.
